evaluation.test_policy: evaluate all four locked candidates only after validation-only selection is persisted; CP1/phase-P-exposed source test is descriptive

provenance.scope: PHASE L.1 LOSS SCREENING ONLY; baseline B1, manifest and initialization reused unchanged; no attention/boundary-head changes or external evaluation
provenance.precision: preserve CP1 torch.float32 and PyTorch 1.11 TF32 defaults; no AMP
provenance.initialization: one shared ImageNet-initialized state_dict, verified tensor-by-tensor for both baselines
provenance.cp1: artifacts immutable; separate CP2 manifest, evaluator policy and run directories

objectives.L3: B1 + fixed 0.01 foreground signed-distance boundary term

tversky.aggregation: entire batch and pixels; no per-image weighting

boundary.empty_mask: zero distance map; regional loss remains active
boundary.reduction: mean over all batch/channel/pixels, including zero-map empty masks
boundary.distance_target_timing: computed from binary ground truth AFTER geometric augmentation in each batch

selection.metric: highest validation Image Dice among eligible selected checkpoints; exact tie favors L0 then L1,L2,L3,L4
selection.candidate_eligibility: validation Image Dice > L0; small-wound Image Dice >= L0; GT-positive TP=0 count <= L0; GT-empty images with FP <= L0
selection.policy_if_none_eligible: retain L0; show all validation trade-offs without claiming an acceptable improvement
selection.caveat: conservative exploratory screening rule, not a clinically validated acceptance threshold
selection.test_access: No candidate test predictions before validation-only selection.json is saved; all four test results reported afterwards

phase_l.scope: L.1 one-seed screening only. Diagnose L.2 factors separately after screening; no automatic L5-L7 matrix, architecture changes, external data or multi-seed confirmation.

selection.status: exploratory one-seed screen; not a clinical acceptance decision
selection.further_phases: No automatic loss-development matrix, architecture or external evaluation
